checks.explanation: D-selection is present on page 1 and all itemized prices are on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The includesText for Basic Services lists arrangements conference, notices, permits, shelter of remains, and coordination with cemetery/crematory/third parties.
No second mandatory fee for facilities, staff or overhead appears; only the single Basic Services fee is listed as non-declinable.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the disclosure on page 1 is the standard permitted wording.
No D-alt-container disclosure is present in the JSON, so placement cannot be evaluated.
The list does not offer direct cremation, so there is no statement about a casket being required for it.
Direct cremation is not offered, so there is no description to compare with a crematory cash advance.
The list includes Forwarding of Remains but does not include separate itemized prices for receiving remains, direct cremation, or immediate burial, which the check treats as expected items.
No optional package combining goods and services at one price is listed; forwarding is a required item, not a package.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires purchase of any item; the embalming disclosure is the required disclaimer.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting a casket/body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts or obscures the required disclosures, which are printed clearly on page 1.
